name: EX-03 Joint Command Post — Co-located, 48h
description: 48-hour around-the-clock joint command post exercise. All participants at the same physical location. Demonstrates battle rhythm, night operations, shift handovers, and continuous command. Uses physical meetings throughout. Shows how to structure a multi-day exercise with night watch and day/night rhythm.

locks.reason: Night admin window D1/D2 — hot food / mandatory rest rotation, no new exercise injections
Night admin window D2/D3 — hot food / mandatory rest rotation, no new exercise injections

items.title: STARTEX
items.description: Exercise begins at the Main Ops Room. All staff report to assigned positions. Synthetic time activated.

items.title: Physical: CP Activation Brief
items.description: On-site at Main Operations Room. All element commanders present. Exercise director activates the command post and confirms communications plan.

items.title: Commander's Initial Brief
items.description: Commander briefs the mission, commander's intent, phase objectives, and decision points for Phase 1.

items.title: Orders Group — Phase 1
items.description: Full orders group. Each element receives their Phase 1 tasks, reporting requirements, and coordination measures.

items.title: Intel Package Distribution
items.description: Intelligence officer distributes Phase 1 intel packages to all element commanders. Confirm receipt and understanding.

items.title: Comms Check All Stations
items.description: Radio/network comms check with all elements. Confirm primary and alternate comms are functioning.

items.title: Physical: Force Deployment Brief
items.description: Map room briefing. All element commanders at the map table. Commander confirms disposition of forces and Phase 1 boundaries.

items.title: Initial SITREP
items.description: First consolidated situation report from all elements. Confirms Phase 1 start state.

items.title: Phase 1 Main Activity
items.description: Phase 1 core exercise activity. Elements execute assigned tasks, process information, and report to the CP.

items.title: Physical: Situation Update Brief
items.description: Ops Room briefing. Standing update at the battle board. Commander addresses emerging issues and adjusts tasks.

items.title: SITREP 1800 D1
items.description: End-of-day situation report. All elements report status to the CP. Summary briefed to commander.

items.title: Night Watch Handover
items.description: Day shift to night watch handover. Outgoing staff brief incoming watch on current situation, outstanding tasks, and night priorities.

items.title: Night Operations — Watch 1
items.description: First night watch (D1 2000–D2 0000). CP maintains minimal essential functions. Reduced staffing. Priority: monitoring and reporting.

items.title: SITREP 0000 D1/D2
items.description: Midnight situation report. Night watch briefs current status, any overnight incidents, and early morning priorities.

items.title: Night Operations — Watch 2
items.description: Second night watch (D2 0000–D2 0600). Continuation of CP monitoring. Pre-brief for D2 morning activity.

items.title: SITREP 0400 D2
items.description: Early morning report from night watch. Covers overnight activity and pre-brief for D2 morning shift.

items.title: Morning Watch Handover
items.description: Night watch to day shift handover standup. Short and sharp. Current situation, key tasks, commander's priorities for D2.

items.title: Physical: Morning Brief D2
items.description: D2 morning brief in Ops Room. All element commanders. Commander outlines Phase 2 intent and adjusts plan based on overnight events.

items.title: Phase 2 Orders Group
items.description: Phase 2 orders issued to all elements. Updated tasks, new coordination measures, fire support plan.

items.title: Phase 2 Main Activity
items.description: Phase 2 core exercise activity. Higher tempo operations, increased reporting requirements.

items.title: SITREP D2 1200
items.description: Midday D2 situation report. Element status, Phase 2 progress, resource consumption.

items.title: Physical: Commanders Conference D2
items.description: Conference room. Commanders-only briefing. Phase 2 assessment and decision for Phase 3.

items.title: SITREP D2 1800
items.description: Evening D2 situation report. Transition status to Phase 3.

items.title: Phase 3 Night Watch Handover
items.description: D2 evening handover to Phase 3 night watch. Priorities: consolidation, preparation for AAR.

items.title: Night Operations D2
items.description: Phase 3 overnight: consolidation operations, AAR preparation, post-exercise administration.

items.title: SITREP D2/D3 0000
items.description: Midnight report from Phase 3 night watch.

items.title: Physical: Final Brief Preparation
items.description: Briefing room. Staff prepare AAR slides and lessons observed summary for the final brief.

items.title: After Action Review
items.description: Full AAR with all participants. Command assessment, element reports, lessons learned discussion.

items.title: ENDEX
items.description: Exercise concluded after 48 hours. All exercise roles released. Synthetic time deactivated.
